# Preserve board card accent stripe on hover/select and distinguish selected hover

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

While building and reviewing `examples/board/multiSelect` (`#21631` / PR `#21734`), two independent passes (`@neo-opus-grace` cold-read `defect-note` `MESSAGE:08796f40` and `@neo-gemini-julia` Cycle-1 review of `#21734`) confirmed two inherited border-state defects in `resources/css/src/board/Card.css`:
1. Hovering or selecting a colored board card (`record.color` -> `--neo-board-card-accent`) overwrites its 3px left accent stripe because `&:hover` (`L20`) and `&.neo-selected` (`L25`) set 4-side shorthand `border-color` without preserving `border-left-color` — forcing `examples/board/multiSelect/Viewport.css:10-12` to carry a local `.neo-board-card.neo-selected` override.
2. Hovering an already-selected card (`&.neo-selected:hover`) produces no visual hover change because `&.neo-selected` (`L23-26`) follows `&:hover` (`L19-21`) at equal `(0,2,0)` specificity.

## The Problem

In `resources/css/src/board/Card.css`:
```css
.neo-board-card {
    background   : var(--neo-board-card-background);
    border       : 1px solid var(--neo-board-card-border-color);
    border-left  : 3px solid var(--neo-board-card-accent, var(--neo-board-card-border-color));
    ...
    &:hover {
        border-color: var(--neo-board-card-hover-border-color);
    }

    &.neo-selected {
        background  : var(--neo-board-card-selected-background, var(--neo-board-card-background));
        border-color: var(--neo-board-card-selected-border-color, var(--neo-board-accent-color));
    }
```
- **Lost left accent stripe on hover and selection:** When a record defines `color` (such as severity `S1`/`S2`/`S3` in `board/multiSelect` or priority accents in `board/basic`), `src/board/Card.mjs` writes `--neo-board-card-accent`. Both `&:hover` and `&.neo-selected` reset all four sides via `border-color`, erasing the card's left accent stripe until drag-start (where `.neo-dragproxy > .neo-board-card, .neo-board-stack .neo-board-stack-lead` at `Card.css:147-148` explicitly restores `border-left-color: var(--neo-board-card-accent, var(--neo-board-card-drag-border-color))`).
- **Indistinguishable hover on selected cards:** Because `&.neo-selected` (`L23`) sits below `&:hover` (`L19`) at identical `(0,2,0)` specificity with no `&.neo-selected:hover` rule, resting the pointer over one card inside a multi-card selection gives zero hover feedback.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/board/Card.mjs:11-12` owns the card accent contract:
  - Design authority: `"src/board/Card.mjs @description: The record's color paints --neo-board-card-accent; the rest is the items' work ({@link Neo.board.CardItems})."` (corroborated by `resources/css/src/board/Card.css:6` and `:147-148`).
- Board theme tokens are authored directly as native CSS in `resources/css/theme-{neo-dark,neo-light,dark,light,cyberpunk}/board/Container.css` (there is no `resources/scss/**/board/` layer), while structural card rules live in `resources/css/src/board/Card.css`.
- Once `Card.css` preserves `border-left-color: var(--neo-board-card-accent, ...)` natively, the local workaround in `resources/css/src/examples/board/multiSelect/Viewport.css:10-12` (once `#21734` is on `dev`) can be removed cleanly (`Accretion Defense`).

## The Fix

1. **Preserve `--neo-board-card-accent` on `&:hover` and `&.neo-selected` in `resources/css/src/board/Card.css`:**
   - In `&:hover`, add `border-left-color: var(--neo-board-card-accent, var(--neo-board-card-hover-border-color));`.
   - In `&.neo-selected`, add `border-left-color: var(--neo-board-card-accent, var(--neo-board-card-selected-border-color, var(--neo-board-accent-color)));`.
2. **Add a distinct `&.neo-selected:hover` state in `resources/css/src/board/Card.css` (and `resources/css/theme-*/board/Container.css` token if needed):**
   - Give `&.neo-selected:hover` a clear hover cue (for example subtle hover elevation/shadow or `color-mix` / dedicated `--neo-board-card-selected-hover-border-color` token across `resources/css/theme-{neo-dark,neo-light,dark,light,cyberpunk}/board/Container.css`) while keeping `border-left-color: var(--neo-board-card-accent, ...)` intact across all 5 board themes.
3. **Retire local workaround & add regression check:**
   - Remove the duplicate `.triage-board .neo-board-card.neo-selected { border-left-color: ... }` override in `resources/css/src/examples/board/multiSelect/Viewport.css` (if `#21734` has merged) and assert computed `borderLeftColor` on a colored `.neo-board-card` across rest, `:hover`, `.neo-selected`, and `.neo-selected:hover` in Playwright component/E2E board coverage.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A `Neo.board.Card` whose record sets `color` (`--neo-board-card-accent`) retains its left accent color across rest, `:hover`, `.neo-selected`, and `.neo-selected:hover` in all five shipped themes.
- [ ] A card with `color: null` (no `--neo-board-card-accent`) continues to show `--neo-board-card-hover-border-color` on hover and `--neo-board-card-selected-border-color` when selected on all four sides.
- [ ] Hovering a `.neo-selected` card produces a visibly distinct computed state from an unhovered `.neo-selected` neighbour (verified with whole-page before/after frames in dark and light themes).
- [ ] Any redundant example-level `.neo-board-card.neo-selected` `border-left-color` workaround (`examples/board/multiSelect/Viewport.css`) is removed, and a Playwright board test asserts computed `borderLeftColor` + selected-hover distinction.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Neo.board.SelectionModel` or `Neo.board.SortZone` JS selection semantics.
- Redesigning Portal `/examples` catalog cards (`#21676`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Omitting fallback on uncolored cards:** Cards with `color: null` do not set `--neo-board-card-accent`, so `var(--neo-board-card-accent, <state-border-color>)` is required so uncolored cards still paint their left border in the hover/selected color.
- **Looking for SCSS under `resources/scss/**/board/`:** `Neo.board` styles are native CSS directly in `resources/css/src/board/Card.css` and `resources/css/theme-*/board/Container.css` (verify coverage parity with `npm run check-theme-coverage` / `npm run check-theme-surfaces` if adding a token).
